resources.string: Turn a photo or drawing into silhouette, outline or color embroidery
Best for clear drawings, logos and handwriting. Pinch to zoom and drag to position. Keep the top-left dot over the background.
Aspect ratio is kept. %1$s–%2$s; recalculates when you let go.
Time is estimated. Unconfirmed machine specifications use assumptions.
A hoop or stitch safety issue blocks transfer. Adjust the crop or detail, or open the editor.
Automatically checked for the selected machine and hoop. Test on matching scrap fabric before sewing.
Photo in hoop frame. Pinch and drag to crop
Unable to open the photo. Choose another image.
Contrast was retried once, but no usable outlines remain. The two-color preview shows the separation. Try clear drawings, logos or handwriting.
Unable to prepare the file for transfer. Try again.
Preview estimate: about 2 seconds. Time varies by image and device.
Taking longer than expected? Try lower detail.
Too many small regions. Lower detail or crop a simpler area.
Outlines were found, but stitches could not be generated. Lower detail or try a simpler crop.
Stitch generation took too long. Lower detail or crop a smaller area.
Generation estimate: about 10 seconds. Time varies; after 30 seconds, try lower detail.
Outline estimate: about 2 seconds. Time varies by image and device.
Transparent pixels are not sewn. The dominant border color is treated as background. Threads are matched automatically to the Brother 64-color chart.
No sewable color regions remain. Try a transparent PNG or a simple drawing with a light background.
